lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 13 distinct white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively consistent across the mid-section, with slightly increased density in the center-torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several posterior and anterior lines are abbreviated; the first two lines on the rump and the final two lines near the shoulder do not extend the full vertical height of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two primary high-contrast circular white spots are located on the upper hind limb/haunch area, arranged in a vertical orientation.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white chevron marking between the eyes, two white spots on the lower cheek, a broad white band at the base of the neck, and white bands/stockings on all four lower limbs.
